_comment: Short-gold priority (town-planner section 4.2, user answer Q5): what is dropped first is the bottom. Steps are spent in this order until the budget is out. 'order' is the default; 'profiles' replaces it for one excursion profile. A line the plan does not model yet (repair, ammo, merc_revive, ...) is listed so the table stays the whole of 4.2 and is skipped by Solve until its card adds it. D3: potions before the first scroll. Numbers are the position in 4.2.
